mapper.sql: ta.id, ta.tenant_id, ta.application_id, ta.status, ta.access_policy, ta.entry_url_override, ta.opened_at, ta.effective_at, ta.expire_at, ta.suspended_at, ta.closed_at, ta.comment, ta.version, a.code AS application_code, a.name AS application_name, a.icon_url, t.name AS tenant_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(ta.entry_url_override, ''), a.entry_url) AS entry_url, CASE WHEN ta.status <> 'ACTIVE' THEN ta.status WHEN a.status <> 'ENABLED' OR a.is_delete <> 0 OR t.available <> 1 OR t.is_delete <> 0 THEN 'UNAVAILABLE' WHEN ta.expire_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP OR t.expire_time <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP THEN 'EXPIRED' WHEN ta.effective_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP THEN 'PENDING' ELSE 'ACTIVE' END AS effective_status
FROM sys_tenant_application ta JOIN sys_application a ON a.id = ta.application_id JOIN sys_tenant t ON t.id = ta.tenant_id WHERE ta.is_delete = 0

sql.if: AND (a.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR t.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select:
SELECT
ORDER BY ta.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT ta.id, ta.version, ta.tenant_id, ta.application_id, ta.status, ta.access_policy, ta.effective_at, ta.expire_at, a.code AS application_code, a.name AS application_name, a.status AS product_status, a.sso_enabled, a.service_id, a.entry_url, a.icon_url, t.available AS tenant_available, t.is_delete AS tenant_deleted, t.expire_time AS tenant_expire, u.id AS user_id, u.username, u.available AS user_available, u.is_delete AS user_deleted, u.credential_version FROM sys_tenant_application ta JOIN sys_application a ON a.id = ta.application_id AND a.is_delete = 0 JOIN sys_tenant t ON t.id = ta.tenant_id JOIN sys_user u ON u.tenant_id = ta.tenant_id AND u.id = #{userId} WHERE ta.id = #{instanceId} AND ta.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ta.is_delete = 0
